answer.book: Rodolphi Hospiniani, De origine et progressu templorum (Tigurum 1587): one volume holding the five-book work De templis (two dedications, index of chapters, index of authors, index of matters, index of scripture passages, bookseller's address to the reader), followed by a separate appended oration, De origine et progressu ritvvm et ceremoniarum ecclesiasticarum (1585), with its own dedicatory epistle.
